heading: Requirement for a permit
lead: A foreign air carrier may provide foreign air transportation only if the foreign air carrier holds a permit issued under this chapter authorizing the foreign air transportation.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 4130149 App.:1372(a).Aug. 23, 1958, Pub. L. 85–726, § 402(a), 72 Stat. 757. The word “provide” is substituted for “engage in” for consistency in the revised title. The word “holds” is substituted for “there is in force” to eliminate unnecessary words.
